name: Vivid Electromech Ltd
tagline: Recently listed SME panel-builder riding the India data-centre capex wave -- excellent returns, ABB/Hitachi tie-ups, a PDU product ramp doubling its TAM, and a trusted user's detailed bull thesis
business_overview: Vivid Electromech (incorporated 1990, listed Apr 2026 on the SME platform) manufactures Low-Voltage and Medium-Voltage electrical switchgear panels and automation systems, project-based and custom-designed. It is an appointed panel-builder partner for ABB (LV/MV panels, ArTuK design) and Hitachi (MV VFD drives), with a Siemens SIVACON licence routed through 99%-owned Mechtech. ~50% of revenue is data centres (works with 6 of the top 10 India hyperscalers -- STT, Adani ConneX, CtrlS), the rest metro rail and industrial. It has launched data-centre Power Distribution Units (PDUs).
fundamentals_table: FY26 revenue ~Rs 200 Cr, PAT ~Rs 32 Cr, OPM ~23%; FY25 Rs 155 Cr / Rs 20 Cr / 18%; FY24 Rs 89 Cr / Rs 4 Cr / 9%
Revenue ~Rs 32.7 Cr, +36% YoY (year is back-ended; H1 FY26 was ~Rs 71 Cr)
FY27 revenue guided >Rs 300 Cr (~+50%); medium-term 35-40% p.a.
~Rs 210 Cr executable (was ~Rs 221 Cr); ticket ~Rs 20-25 Cr per DC project (~Rs 1.25 Cr/MW IT load)
Ambernath (Maharashtra) ~119,800 sq ft -- 3x verticals (7,500 -> 22,500/yr); Phase 1 by end-Aug 2026, full commissioning Oct 2026
Debt ~Rs 33 Cr at Mar 2026 (up from ~Rs 4 Cr); debtor days ~212 -- working-capital heavy; no pledge; promoter ~73.5%
fundamentals_narrative: Small revenue base (~Rs 200 Cr FY26) with exceptional, structurally improving returns: OPM stepped 9% -> 18% -> 23% across FY24-26 as COGS fell from ~85% to ~64% on the mix shift toward data-centre PDUs and DWDM/MV panels -- a genuine value-curve move, not a cyclical spike. Q1 FY27 revenue ~Rs 32.7 Cr (+36% YoY) looks optically soft but the year is heavily back-ended (H1 FY26 was only ~Rs 71 Cr of a Rs 200 Cr full year). The dated catalyst is the Ambernath facility (~119,800 sq ft, 3x vertical capacity): Phase 1 by end-Aug 2026, full commissioning Oct 2026, underpinning the >Rs 300 Cr FY27 revenue guidance. Order intake through the quarter was strong -- STT Global Rs 30.1 Cr (PDU/DWDM), Univastu Rs 20.2 Cr (MV switchgear), Cosmic PV / solar-park / wastewater Rs 52.8 Cr (Aug 2026) -- even though the stated executable book is flat at ~Rs 210 Cr. Caveats: an SME-platform stock that has run to ~3x issue price, a full ~44x trailing multiple, ~212 debtor days and debt up to ~Rs 33 Cr (working-capital intensity), a short listed history (Apr 2026) with no public guidance track record, and OEMs (e.g. Siemens' CS Electric buy) potentially in-sourcing panel assembly.
technical_read: Not pulled -- SME stock, sharp post-listing run to ~3x issue price then a pullback; thin float means single-lot buying can move it to circuits.
